title: Sunrise Foods plans for growth
body: Sunrise Foods Ltd. has set the objective of increasing its sales by 20% in the next financial year. All its managers have agreed to assume that demand for packaged food will grow by 8%, interest rates will remain stable and tax rates will not change. The managers then proposed three ways forward: opening outlets in two new cities, launching a ready-to-cook range, and starting online sales. For each option, the finance team worked out expected earnings, interest costs, taxes and risks. Online sales offered moderate returns with low risk, while new outlets promised higher returns with higher risk. After discussion, the board decided to combine online sales with the ready-to-cook range. New machines were then purchased and extra workers were hired. Every month, the sales head checks whether actual sales are on schedule.
